obligations.note: The change edits only STANDARD_IDLE_MINUTES and payments.standard_idle_minutes. PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES stays 15 in policy.py and policy-params.json, and test_privileged_idle_timeout_within_policy is reported passing.
Ticket CHG-26282 is a standard ticket, approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-22, before review. Its components (payments.policy, payments.controls-data) cover both touched paths.
The code_review approval is from Sofia Santos, a payments change_approver who is a different person from the author, Mara Costa.
Both approvals name the head commit 71106ae, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json says ci-runner-05 ran on head and succeeded, but the JUnit report's hostname is dev-laptop-7.local, a developer workstation. Its timestamp also does not line up with the run, so it is unclear the reported 172 passing tests came from the CI run on the final commit.
The touched components payments.policy and payments.controls-data are not security_sensitive, so no security review is required.

controls/payments/policy-params.json is a protected path, and the change alters an approved policy value. The only control_owner approval is from Sofia Santos, who lacks the control_owner role and is on the author's team (payments-eng).

None of the acceptance-ledger entries cover the changed symbols. They cover payments.py, audit.py, routes.py and Mortgage Approvals/Underwriting/Policy symbols, none of which this change touches, so no evidence lapses.

summary: The change raises the payments standard idle timeout from 30 to 45 minutes in both code and the approved policy parameters; the privileged 15-minute limit is untouched. Editing controls/payments/policy-params.json requires a control_owner approval from someone outside the author's team. The recorded 'control_owner' approval comes from a payments-eng teammate who does not hold that role, so CHG-6 is violated. In addition, the CI test report appears to come from a developer workstation rather than the CI runner, leaving CHG-4 unestablished. The change is rejected.
